title: Unlocking the Nebula: A Failsafe Aftermath
summary: Under a shimmering nebula, ancient machinery unlocks, its intricate lines syncing within a vast network. A lone teenager, our protagonist, tirelessly works on the decking, surrounded by a surplus of strange parts and the looming shadows of jackals. Through cryptic spaces, she navigates varied dangers, a katana her only companion, constantly battling the hideous slime and the jading influence of oligarchs. A desperate attempt to amplify the signal reveals a colossal fuckup as worms infest the wiring and a ginger-haired schnook is whipped away by unseen killers. In the aftermath, a new reality emerges, a sweet mixture of hope and uncertainty. The machinery, now still, becomes a novelty. She finds a new uniform and cookery, adapting to an enhanced world, a testament to her trusted spirit.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
